decision_rule: As in round 1 (poles rounds 3-5, ships). Corrected = the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement as stated, places a company-level fact at the plant, ties a posting or fact to the plant through a location shared by several sites (campus rule, consultation 10), or the quote is not on the page (raw source checked before calling a JSON/JSON-LD quote missing). Confirmed = the cited page, or for a multi-row claim a sibling row's page opened 2026-11-16, carries every additive clause. Not additive: limiting parentheticals ('as of 2015', 'company-level', 'products not stated'), technical glosses, rubric labels, and provenance labels that name the source of a fact ('(Welder and Fit-up Welder postings, Mount Vernon)', '(production Welder postings, Yankton)'). This call is applied to all four single-row weld_processes values, each of whose other named postings were opened today and carry the same process. Opening lines: every clause carried by a stated row of a claim named in the reasoning, or by that row's page; ends in a 'you' question; no pitch language; no Path deployment asserted at a Coperion site (mining rule 5). Labor: each counted posting re-read live today on the employer's own board (Terex and Hillenbrand Workday API via headless browser; Astec BrightMove state listings; McLanahan UKG list; GK Paylocity).
